name: @fixtures/projects-root
description: The Fixture_Projects_Root: a single npm workspace root whose members are the hostile Project_Fixtures under it. One install (fixtures:install) serves every member. The workspaces globs match member packages inside each scenario (<scenario>/packages/<category>/<member>) and the Entry_Package at <scenario>/app, and never a scenario's own directory, so npm never reads a scenario's own workspaces array and the two workspace roots do not nest. A scenario whose fault requires its own Framework_Singleton packages to resolve by name (image-tree--no-dist) lists those specific member paths, the sanctioned exception for a scenario whose members do not fit the general globs.
